acceptanceCriteria: A1: the controlled-repository test proves the displayed preflight state, explicitly test-data-selected option, and actual checkpoint transition agree.
A2: the test proves an interrupted verification does not create a false pass and a fresh retry/resume produces current evidence and the corresponding Runtime state.
A3: the test identifies all simulated human decisions as test data and does not write a real authorization record outside the temporary fixture.
A4: tri-language contract, scenario matrix, invariant coverage, README, Work Item, and reference-parity projections describe the new evidence without claiming external participant validation.
goal: Provide executable evidence that state/option/behavior remain aligned without external participants or production behavior changes.
intent: Close the collaboration-language section IV gap with a controlled-repository consistency check that compares displayed state, a test-data-selected option, and actual Runtime behavior across interruption and resume.
outOfScope: production Runtime behavior and Contract/Outcome schema changes
new external authorization records; simulated human decisions remain test data

scenarioCoverage.expected: the test-data selection confirm_review is visible in the preflight request and checkpoint accepts only after the matching fixture receipt
scenarioCoverage.scenario: displayed preflight option and checkpoint behavior
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: run collaboration_consistency test and retain its verification receipt

scenarioCoverage.expected: an interrupted verification does not publish a passing evidence receipt or advance the Work Item
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: terminate the controlled verification subprocess, inspect status/outcome, and retain the test result

scenarioCoverage.expected: a fresh retry after the interruption publishes current evidence and the displayed Runtime state advances accordingly
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: rerun the controlled verification, inspect status/outcome, and retain the test result
